name: kickwick
description: Football & cricket tournament management — Laravel API + React client

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "API,WS,QUEUE,CLIENT" -c "cyan,magenta,yellow,emerald" "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:ws" "npm run dev:queue" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.setup: npm run setup:api && npm --prefix client install
scripts.setup:api: cd backend && composer install && php artisan migrate:fresh --seed
